# Agenda Capoeiragem

> Agenda Capoeiragem is the global capoeira directory and community management platform. It connects capoeira practitioners, educators, groups (grupos), and training locations (núcleos) worldwide.

Capoeira is an Afro-Brazilian martial art that combines elements of dance, acrobatics, and music. Recognized as a UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage since 2014, capoeira is practiced worldwide and is characterized by fluid movements, the berimbau (musical bow), and a ritualized sparring game called "jogo da capoeira."

Agenda Capoeiragem has two components: a **public directory** (web) to find capoeira groups, núcleos, and educators worldwide, and a **mobile app** with management tools for educators — attendance tracking, graduation system, payments, and event management.

It is built for **practitioners (alunos)** looking for where to train, **educators (professores, mestres, contramestres)** managing students and graduations, and **travelers** looking for capoeira classes in any city.

Key terms used throughout the platform: **grupo** (a capoeira organization or school with its own graduation system and methodology, e.g. Angola, Regional, Contemporânea), **núcleo** (a specific training location within a grupo, with address, schedule, and responsible educator), **educador** (a teacher, holding titles such as Aluno, Instrutor, Professor, Contra-Mestre, or Mestre depending on the group's system), **corda** (the belt/graduation level — colored cords instead of karate-style belts), **jogo** (the sparring game played in the roda), **roda** (the circle formed by capoeiristas and musicians), **berimbau** (the single-string bow instrument that leads the roda), and **mestre** (the highest traditional title in capoeira).

The directory currently lists groups and educators primarily in Latin America, with expansion ongoing. Each entry includes the group's description and graduation system, training locations with address/city/country, class schedules, and educator profiles with bios and social links.

This platform does not currently offer a public API. All directory data is available on the public website; for partnerships or data access, contact the team via the platform.

## Docs

- [Directory (Spanish)](https://www.agendacapoeiragem.com/es): Browse capoeira groups, núcleos, and educators worldwide
- [Directory (Portuguese)](https://www.agendacapoeiragem.com/pt): Same directory in Portuguese
- [Directory (English)](https://www.agendacapoeiragem.com/en): Same directory in English
- [Tutorials](https://www.agendacapoeiragem.com/es/tutoriales): Guides for using the platform

## Optional

- [Android app](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.agendacapoeiragem): Educator management tools — attendance, graduations, payments, events
